item.title: How to Organize a Deep Pantry by Shelf Depth and Food Type
item.description: A deep pantry can hold plenty of food and still waste it. Packages hide behind one another, duplicates get bought and ingredients expire at the back. The problem is rarely too few containers. It is that the back row has no reliable way to come forward. This guide measures the shelf, divides it into front, pull-forward and backstock zones, works through the arithmetic for lanes and bins and shows how to group food by routine instead of by label.
